verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships its own interactive Swagger UI API reference, generated from a published OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec with 67 /v1 paths. It is served at /api/docs on each instance, so a user can explore endpoints and execute calls against their own workspace. The reference exists only inside a running self-hosted or desktop instance: there is no public or vendor-hosted interactive reference, and the docs-site OpenAPI paths return 404. Runnable calls also require a live API key. missing for 10: a publicly hosted interactive reference or demo sandbox, explicit documentation of runnable request examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the try-it experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can find the API documentation for available endpoints on your instance at /api/docs
API endpoints that enable programmatic reading, writing, and updating of your AnythingLLM instance. UI supplied by Swagger.io.
